D2C founders run their business across Meta, Google, Shopify, Amazon, and a dozen spreadsheets, and still can't say which rupee of ad spend actually made a profit. Flable AI fixes that.

We're building Orion, an AI marketing agent that connects a brand's ad, commerce, and marketplace data into one profit-first view. Our AI "CMO" gives founders in minutes what used to take an analyst a week.

* Understanding of D2C, e-commerce, or performance marketing

Why Flable

* Work directly with the founders on an AI product that's already live with 100+ D2C brands
